builds.title: Terminal: tab position setting (top, left / right stack, bottom)
builds.detail: Brett (Nov 3 2026, voice): "I want a setting in terminal to put all the tabs on the left side in a stack instead of across the top." Setting Tab position: Top | Left stack | Right stack | Bottom, per device, also in the tab context menu. Stack: title, agent, model, live cost, status dot, close; collapse to icons; resizable; drag to reorder; scrolls; title bar still drags. Phone: slide-out. Server default + REST/MCP/CLI get/set. Agent: Janitor Joey (headless worktree session; router not on this branch's main). Overlaps: terminal-sessions-nav (#286, open, adds a left rail) and terminal-drag-chain-tree (running, rewrites strip pointer handling): changes kept to a new TabStack file + CSS so all three merge cleanly.
